mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with prochlorperazine (antipsychotic) increases risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and excessive CNS depression through monoamine potentiation and additive pharmacodynamic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with close monitoring for hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome symptoms, and CNS depression.
